Our Story

A little green trailer, a lot of heart.

Kiwi Coffee is a cozy neighbourhood coffee stand parked beside the riverside walk in Churchill Gardens — a converted horse trailer turned into one of Salisbury's favourite coffee stops.

Every cup is pulled from carefully selected beans, roasted locally, and made with a smile. Whether you're stopping mid-walk, watching the skatepark, or just need your daily flat white, this is a place built for slowing down for five minutes.

Handcrafted coffee. Honest ingredients. A view of the trees.

Signature Drinks

Handcrafted, cup by cup.

Every drink is pulled to order on our espresso machine, finished with steamed milk and a little latte-art heart — the way it should be.
